acquiredutils.gui.title: AcquiredUtils Settings
acquiredutils.gui.desc.slot_lock: Protect inventory slots from accidental changes.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.item_pickup_notif: Show colored notifications for recognized rare item pickups.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.notification_dura: Set how long pickup notifications stay visible.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.edit_hud: Choose where pickup notifications appear on your screen.
acquiredutils.gui.edit_hud.title: Edit HUD - Notification Position
acquiredutils.gui.edit_hud.hint: Drag the notification to choose its position
acquiredutils.gui.desc.menu_scale: Adjust the size of the AcquiredUtils settings menu.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.recipe_unlock_hig: Highlight unlocked recipes inside supported recipe vaults.
acquiredutils.gui.search.tooltip: Search settings by name or description.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.rarity_circle: Show a small transparent rarity circle around items that contain a recognized rarity.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.rarity_minimum: Choose the lowest rarity that receives a circle marker.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.rarity_circle_siz: Adjust the size of the rarity circle so it stays subtle without hiding the item.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.rarity_circle_opa: Adjust how visible the rarity circle is while keeping the item fully readable.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.item_comparison: Compare recognized equipment stats against the item you currently have equipped.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.hud_preset: Quickly place pickup notifications in a clean preset position before fine-tuning them with Edit HUD.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.auto_hotbar: Automatically protect all hotbar slots from accidental clicks, drops, and swaps.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.auto_inventory: Automatically protect the main inventory slots from accidental changes.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.auto_armor: Automatically protect equipped armor slots from accidental changes.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.auto_offhand: Automatically protect the offhand slot from accidental changes.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.lock_all: Lock all player inventory slots at once using manual slot locks.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.unlock_all: Clear every manually locked slot. Automatic category protection remains active.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.keybind_inventory: Press this key while your player inventory is open to search item names and highlight matching slots.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.search_inventory: Highlight inventory items whose names match the search text while you browse your player inventory.
acquiredutils.gui.compare.title: Comparison
